title: Grateful Dead Live at Gulfstream Park Racetrack on 1968-12-29
lineage: SBD > MC > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy late‑1968 Miami Pop Festival set, highlighted by a smoking Other One and thunderous Eleven jam.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers surprisingly crisp, almost studio‑quality sound for a 1968 outdoor festival, with the drums→Other One→Cryptical segment standing out. Musically the show is a short but ferocious burst of classic ’68 material – Dark Star, St. Stephen, a tight Eleven, and an incendiary Other One that showcases Jerry’s guitar on fire. Overall it’s a must‑have for any 1968 Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating ~4.3, with overwhelming praise for both performance and sound quality; the weighting favors a strong show and excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix praised as very good for the era; occasional comments about slight over‑mixing in the right ear but overall highly listenable and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical late‑68 battle‑like set, short but intense with rapid transitions; the drums→Other One→Cryptical segment drives the momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as ‘blasting like a fire engine’, manic leads and on‑fire guitar work especially during The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for focused interplay with Jerry during the Eleven jam, delivering powerful bass moments.
band_member_comments.Drums: Explosive drum work highlighted in the drums→Other One→Cryptical segment; overall tight and driving.
